attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the persistent OPNsense gateway for WAN 172.16.10.0/24, LAN 10.10.10.0/24, and DMZ 10.20.20.0/24. node2 serves “infraset-dmz” on 8080; WAN receives only the tagged 8443 publication, LAN receives direct 8080 access, and WAN/DMZ-initiated LAN connections remain blocked. All four nodes passed sequential reboot-persistence verification.
